dataset.title: Jobs
dataset.description: One row per open job. Rows with status FOUND carry the job; NO_JOBS and error rows are free and only appear if you asked for them.

report.title: Per-board report
report.description: How many jobs each board really has, how many were delivered, whether the run was truncated and whether the answer came from cache.

summary.title: Run summary
summary.description: Totals for the whole run: boards read, boards failed, jobs delivered, cache hits, seconds.
